auditedPrs.notes: Squash commit 041861c. The PR ports no Go. It drops the crates.io `no-std` category from ts_netstack_smoltcp, ts_netstack_smoltcp_core and ts_netstack_smoltcp_socket, because flume links std. It also adds explanatory comments, a README 'Platform support' section, and a `no_std_honest` check in `checks`. Runtime behaviour, defaults and error paths are unchanged. Compared against upstream tailscale/tailscale at the PORTING.md pin e2ed432399c9b0fda7aa14e9eb27784d2d893c55 (shallow-fetched). Upstream's netstack is wgengine/netstack on gVisor, and no .go file at that ref mentions no_std, no-std or flume. So the PR has no upstream counterpart to diverge from, and there are no findings.

gate.detail: Ran the scoped gate stages on main 3b147cb with CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4 and RUST_TEST_THREADS=4. All passed: cargo run -p checks; clippy --lib -D warnings; clippy on bins/tests/benches/examples with -D warnings -A missing_docs; nextest on geiserx_ts_control and geiserx_ts_runtime (986 passed, 3 known-hanging socket tests filtered out); cargo build --all-targets --all-features. All workspace-wide stages excluded ts_cli_util. The full bin/check was not run: its tracy feature does not compile under --all-features, and cargo deny refuses aws-lc-rs/aws-lc-sys on every branch, which stops the set -e script.
